title: Nuevo modelo open source: LFM3-1.7B
dek: LFM3-1.7B is a text model for local agents and specialized applications, based on our new tri-hybrid architecture.
body:
LFM3-1.7B is a text model for local agents and specialized applications, based on our new tri-hybrid architecture.

## Ficha rápida

- LiquidAI/LFM3-1.7B
- 1.7B parámetros
- VRAM mínima estimada 1.5 GB (CPU / móvil)
- ~400 tok/s en RTX 4090 (Q4)
- licencia other
- 655 likes en Hugging Face

## Descripción original

LFM3-1.7B is a text model for local agents and specialized applications, based on our new tri-hybrid architecture.

- Agentic training: post-trained for agentic harnesses such as Hermes Agent, Pi, and OpenClaw, with a 256K-token context window. - Designed for the edge: at 4-bit precision, it takes about 1 GB of memory, so it fits on any phone or laptop. - Made to be specialized: adapt the model to your domains, formats, and tools via quick single-GPU fine-tuning.

Find more information about the LFM3 family in our release blog post.

The LFM3 family includes base, text, vision, audio, omni, and decision models.
